nom: DERMA E Dead Sea Salt Microdermabrasion Scrub

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report the scrub balances excess oil and leaves skin smooth and clean without over-drying, with one noting it did not leave her face oily or gross.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers say it removes flaky/dead skin and softens rough patches without over-drying, though a few note temporary tightness that moisturizer resolves.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as balancing, smoothing, and non-irritating when used with a light hand.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly say it is gentle enough with light pressure and infrequent use, though several report mild irritation, redness, or breakouts if scrubbed too hard or used on already-inflamed skin.
segments.mature: Mature and aging-skin reviewers (40s-60s) report softer, smoother, more refreshed-looking skin, with one describing it as the only exfoliant her post-menopausal skin tolerates.
segments.normal: The one reviewer describing normal-to-oily skin found it hydrating without adding oil and noted improved texture.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with mature or wrinkled skin report smoother, softer, more refreshed-looking skin and some reduction in the appearance of fine lines.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or flaky skin report reduced flaking and softer, smoother skin after use, though a couple mention temporary tightness right after rinsing.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness and improved overall texture over repeated use; one reviewer notes her face turns red immediately after scrubbing but calms by morning.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer was warned not to use it daily to protect the skin barrier, and another reports it caused small tears in her skin, leading her to switch to a gentler product.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers with acne scars or dark spots/hyperpigmentation report visible fading and reduced redness of marks after repeated use, including scars over ten years old.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report clearer skin, faded blackheads, and no new breakouts with gentle use; however, a few report the product burned, caused breakouts, cystic pimples, or a bad rash.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the scrub removes excess oil and leaves skin smooth without stripping or increasing oiliness.

extraits.texte: I read through the reviews and felt confident this product would be a good fit for me and be effective. I don't really splurge on things like this often bevause I can't, and I was dissapointed I did. The product kind of burned and led to some breakouts. Again, i could just have a different skin type that doesn't agree with the ingredients. I do urge you if you have sensitive, acne prone skin to keep in mind that this aggravated breakouts for me.

extraits.titre: Favorite facial exfoliation product for years
extraits.texte: I have loved/ used the DermE dead sea microdermabrasion scrub for years. It is pricey for the size but it is effective. It does not irritate my sensitive skin and a little goes a long way so it does last. I ran out over a month ago and did not rebuy because I'm trying to save money. My skin has become moody since hitting menopause, perimeno did not really give me akin issies. Now its a whole new story. My skin has become sensitive to all of my HG products exceot this one. Ive had to try so many new products to find any that help the changes including all of my HG make-up and it became expensive. What really stinks is most anti-aging ingredients that are effective and any chemical exfoliant products all make me react now. I decided to buy this during a sale since I know it wirks abd diesnt make my skin wirse. So hapoy I did. It exfoliates but doesnt make my skin dry out or get red. I use it 1-2x's a week while in the shower. Cons: the high proce for 1.7oz, the glass jar is not ideal hygienically or to use in the shower . I use a product scooper to dispense some before I get in the shower and leave it on the lid. I wish DermE made a larger size. The Ingredients are pretty solid and the fine sized particles still make it feel like im getting a good manual topical scrub going. My face is noticeably softer and less flaky afterwards. I highly recommend the product!

This stuff is amazing and the smell is out of this world! I have serious acne prone/sensitive skin and I cannot stress enough how much it has helped the appearance and texture of my acne scarring. You do have to be careful not to scrub too hard or for too long, and my face usually does end up red after I wash it off. But I use it before bed and apply a good serum and moisturizer and in the morning my skin has a more even completion and feels silky smooth. I use about 1-2 times a week on WET skin, and definitely don't recommend using it on your lips. Plus, the best part is you honestly don't need a lot so it'll last you quite a while.

My skin is oily, but because I have psoriasis it also tends to be very flaky. I am also highly allergic to salicylic acid, so it's difficult for me to find an effective exfoliator that does not contain this ingredient. This product fits the bill perfectly. I sometimes follow it up with a soothing tea tree oil sheet mask, but I find that it does not irritate my skin as long as I moisturize well after using. My skin texture is so much better when using this product.

There is definitely a reason this product has basically no bad reviews. I have been struggling with a change in my skin over the past year or so and have spent hundreds of dollars trying to find products to help it. I struggle largely with redness, dryness, and overall poor texture. This solved all of those issues almost completely after just one use. This scrub does exactly what it says it will at a fraction of the cost of most other hyped up skincare brands. I wish I had found it sooner and saved myself the money.

extraits.titre: My Skin is Smoother, Less Red from Scarring and Soft!
extraits.texte: I use this product twice a week, as directed. I am in my 30s with adult acne-prone skin. I have red marks on my forehead, cheeks, and even my neck. I have only used this twice, but I have noticed a big difference in the redness and brownness of my acne scars. I first clean my face, then wet it again with lukewarm water. After that, I take about a dime size of this scrub and rub it very gently in circular motions on my face and neck where I have the scars. After that, I rinse with lukewarm water and pat to dry. It does make my face red afterwards, so I only use it at night. By the morning, however, my face is bright and smooth, and the acne scars have lessened. I have scars that are over ten years old, and this is helping to fade them! I highly recommend this!

My wife and I both use this! I lucked out with naturally clear and soft skin, so this and a good sunscreen is just great for prepping my face for my phototherapy sessions. Meanwhile, she has facial hair that makes the skin on her chin and jawline a little thicker and tougher. When she uses this before a shave and a good moisturizer after (we like Pacifica) she comes out soft and super smooth! Best tip is to only use this every other day. It does scrub very well, and daily use might cause breakouts.
